speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Risperidone-induced Akathisia.

The clinical picture of inner restlessness and an inability to sit still, following the initiation of risperidone, is classic for drug-induced akathisia. The normal MRI, EEG, and neurological exam further support a medication side effect rather than a primary neurological disorder. Given the improvement in psychotic symptoms, we should consider reducing the risperidone dose or adding a beta-blocker to manage the akathisia.
